---
title: "NBL Predict Proliferation Score"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
params:
  load_data: FALSE
  # nfolds: 30
  n_repeats: 20       # repeats of the outer cross-validation
  n_outer_folds: 5    # outer folds, for estimating test performance
  n_inner_folds: 10   # inner folds, for choosing lambda
  lambda_rule: "lambda.min"   # or "lambda.1se"
---

# Setup and data import

```{r setup, message = F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggfortify)
library(kableExtra)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
library(GSVA)
library(GSEABase)
library(glmnet)
library(jsonlite)

getSampleID <- function(s) {
  paste(strsplit(s, "-", fixed = TRUE)[[1]][1:4], collapse = "-")
}

consts <- read_json(file.path(repo_dir, 'config.json'))
proj_dir <- file.path(consts[['official_indir']], 'TARGET')

proliferation.scores <- as.data.frame(readRDS(file.path(proj_dir, 'TARGET_ssGSEA_scores.rds')))
row.names(proliferation.scores) <- sapply(row.names(proliferation.scores), getSampleID)
  
clinical <- read.table(file.path(proj_dir, 'clinical.processed.tsv'), sep='\t', header=T)
clinical$in_analysis_dataset <- as.logical(clinical$in_analysis_dataset)
analysis.samples <- clinical$sampleID[clinical$in_analysis_dataset]

analysis.withExpr <- intersect(analysis.samples, row.names(proliferation.scores))
analysis.noExpr <- setdiff(analysis.samples, row.names(proliferation.scores))

proliferation.scores <- proliferation.scores[analysis.withExpr,]

gene_meth_filepath <- file.path(proj_dir, 'gene_meth.rds')
```

Out of the analysis cohort of `r length(analysis.samples)` samples, `r length(analysis.withExpr)` have proliferation scores from expression data.

# Calculate gene-level methylation from TARGET DNA methylation data

## CpG annotation and promoter selection

```{r cpg-annotations, eval=!params$load_data || (!file.exists(gene_meth_filepath))}
methyl <- readRDS(file.path(proj_dir, 'cohort1.methyl.rds'))
colnames(methyl) <- sapply(colnames(methyl), getSampleID)

anno <- getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)

anno_sub <- anno[rownames(methyl), ]

promoter_cpgs <- anno_sub[
  anno_sub$Relation_to_Island %in% c("Island", "N_Shore", "S_Shore") &
    grepl("TSS1500|TSS200|5'UTR|1stExon", anno_sub$UCSC_RefGene_Group),
]

Clock_fCpGs <- read.table(file.path(repo_dir, "3. Select fCpGs", "outputs", "NBL_Clock_CpGs.txt"))$V1
n.intersect <- length(intersect(rownames(promoter_cpgs), Clock_fCpGs))

promoter_cpgs <- promoter_cpgs[!rownames(promoter_cpgs) %in% Clock_fCpGs,]
```

CpG probes were annotated using the appropriate Illumina array annotation package (e.g., IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno). Probes were retained if they mapped to promoter-associated regions, defined as CpGs annotated to TSS1500, TSS200, 5′UTR, or 1stExon, and located within CpG islands or shores (N_Shore, S_Shore). `r n.intersect` probes were removed for being Clock CpGs.

## Mapping CpGs to genes

```{r mapping-cpgs, eval=!params$load_data || (!file.exists(gene_meth_filepath))}
cpg_to_gene <- data.frame(
  cpg = rownames(promoter_cpgs),
  gene = promoter_cpgs$UCSC_RefGene_Name
)

# handle multiple genes per CpG
cpg_to_gene <- tidyr::separate_rows(cpg_to_gene, gene, sep = ";")

cpg_to_gene <- cpg_to_gene[
  !is.na(cpg_to_gene$gene) & cpg_to_gene$gene != "",
]
```

Promoter-associated CpGs were mapped to genes using the UCSC RefGene annotation. Probes annotated to multiple genes were expanded such that each CpG–gene pair was treated independently. CpGs without valid gene annotations were excluded.

## Aggregation to gene-level promoter methylation

```{r aggregate-promoter-methylation, eval=!params$load_data || (!file.exists(gene_meth_filepath))}
gene_meth <- sapply(unique(cpg_to_gene$gene), function(g) {
  cpgs <- cpg_to_gene$cpg[cpg_to_gene$gene == g]
  colMeans(methyl[cpgs, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
}) # samples x genes

n.na <- colSums(is.na(gene_meth))
gene_meth <- as.data.frame(gene_meth[, n.na == 0])

saveRDS(gene_meth, gene_meth_filepath)
```

```{r load-gene-meth, eval=params$load_data && file.exists(gene_meth_filepath)}
gene_meth <- readRDS(gene_meth_filepath)
```


For each gene, promoter methylation was summarized by taking the mean $\beta$-value across all associated promoter CpGs for each sample, resulting in a gene-by-sample matrix representing average promoter methylation per gene.

# LASSO regression model

## Create x and y objects for the model

```{r create-x-y-objs}
# Extract sample IDs and make them the row names
# row.names(gene_meth) <- lapply(row.names(gene_meth), getSampleID)

# Create x and y objects for model
stopifnot(all(row.names(proliferation.scores) %in% row.names(gene_meth)))
y <- rowMeans(proliferation.scores[, c("HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS", "HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT"), ])
sample.list <- row.names(proliferation.scores)
x <- as.matrix(gene_meth[sample.list,])
stopifnot(sum(is.na(x)) == 0)
stopifnot(sum(is.na(y)) == 0)
```

Using `r length(y)` samples. Response variable is the mean of the HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS and HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT scores.

## Evaluate the model with repeated nested cross-validation

The test performance of the whole modeling procedure (choosing $\lambda$ by `r params$n_inner_folds`-fold cross-validation, then fitting the lasso model) is estimated with `r params$n_repeats` repeats of `r params$n_outer_folds`-fold cross-validation. In each outer fold, $\lambda$ is chosen by cross-validation on the training folds only, and the model is evaluated on the held-out fold. Within each repeat, the held-out predictions from all outer folds are pooled, so every sample gets exactly one out-of-sample prediction, and the performance metrics are computed from them. The mean and standard deviation of each metric across repeats are reported.

```{r nested-cv}
# RMSE
rmse <- function(y, pred) sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2))

# R-squared, as the proportion of variance explained (1 - SSE/SST)
rsq <- function(y, pred) 1 - sum((y - pred)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)

# Squared Pearson correlation between observed and predicted values
rsq_cor <- function(y, pred) cor(y, pred)^2

set.seed(0)

repeat_results <- NULL
fold_results <- NULL
for (r in seq_len(params$n_repeats)) {

  # Assign each sample to an outer fold
  outer_folds <- sample(rep(seq_len(params$n_outer_folds), length.out = nrow(x)))

  # Held-out predictions for every sample in this repeat
  y.pred_test <- rep(NA, length(y))

  for (k in seq_len(params$n_outer_folds)) {
    test_idx <- which(outer_folds == k)

    # Choose lambda by cross-validation on the training folds only
    cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
      x[-test_idx, ], y[-test_idx],
      alpha = 1,
      family = "gaussian",
      nfolds = params$n_inner_folds
    )

    y.pred_test[test_idx] <- as.numeric(predict(cv_fit, newx = x[test_idx, ], s = params$lambda_rule))

    fold_results <- rbind(fold_results, data.frame(
      Repeat = r,
      Fold = k,
      lambda = cv_fit[[params$lambda_rule]],
      n_genes = sum(coef(cv_fit, s = params$lambda_rule)[-1] != 0)
    ))
  }

  repeat_results <- rbind(repeat_results, data.frame(
    Repeat = r,
    RMSE = rmse(y, y.pred_test),
    R_squared = rsq(y, y.pred_test),
    R_squared_cor = rsq_cor(y, y.pred_test)
  ))
}

# Summarize the performance metrics across repeats
metrics <- c("RMSE", "R_squared", "R_squared_cor")
results <- data.frame(
  Metric = metrics,
  Mean = sapply(metrics, function(m) mean(repeat_results[[m]])),
  SD = sapply(metrics, function(m) sd(repeat_results[[m]])),
  Min = sapply(metrics, function(m) min(repeat_results[[m]])),
  Max = sapply(metrics, function(m) max(repeat_results[[m]]))
)

kable(results, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE,
      caption = sprintf("Held-out performance across %d repeats of %d-fold cross-validation",
                        params$n_repeats, params$n_outer_folds)) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

cat(sprintf('Standard deviation of response variable: %.2f\n', sd(y)))
cat(sprintf('Lambda (%s) across outer folds: median %.3g, range %.3g - %.3g\n',
            params$lambda_rule, median(fold_results$lambda), min(fold_results$lambda), max(fold_results$lambda)))
cat(sprintf('Genes with non-zero coefficients across outer folds: median %d, range %d - %d\n',
            as.integer(median(fold_results$n_genes)), min(fold_results$n_genes), max(fold_results$n_genes)))
```

## Retrain lasso model on all labeled data

We will train the final model using 100% of the labeled data: `r nrow(x)` samples, choosing $\lambda$ with the same `r params$n_inner_folds`-fold cross-validation used above. Then, we will predict the proliferation score values for the unlabeled data.

```{r retrain}
set.seed(0)
cv_fit_final <- cv.glmnet(
  x, y,
  alpha = 1,
  family = "gaussian",
  nfolds = params$n_inner_folds
)

stopifnot(all(analysis.noExpr %in% row.names(gene_meth)))
x_unlabeled <- as.matrix(gene_meth[analysis.noExpr,])
y_unlabeled_pred <- as.data.frame(predict(
  cv_fit_final,
  newx = x_unlabeled,
  s = params$lambda_rule
))
names(y_unlabeled_pred) = c('proliferation_score')

results <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Labeled set", "Predicted values"),
  Mean = c(mean(y), mean(y_unlabeled_pred$proliferation_score)),
  Stdev = c(sd(y), sd(y_unlabeled_pred$proliferation_score))
)

cat('Proliferation score distributions:')
kable(results, digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)


# Combined known and predicted scores
scores_all <- rbind(y_unlabeled_pred, data.frame(proliferation_score=y))
write.table(scores_all, file.path(proj_dir, 'TARGET_ssGSEA_scores_all.tsv'),
            quote=F, sep='\t')
```
